title: Subagent roles
lede: Agent roles, shared state files, external surfaces, and the prompt rules defining their authority. Every node and edge cites the corresponding prompt block.

nodes.label: orchestrator
nodes.summary: Top-level coordinator. Production work is delegated. It dispatches standing singletons and work agents, writes the heartbeat on every loop, waits only via bounded wait_for_notification, and never accesses Modal sandboxes, billing, or submit_gate() directly. Sub-agents receive the full prompt, with individual scope defined by the orchestrator brief.

nodes.label: SETUP
nodes.summary: Initial sub-agent, dispatched at T0 while the orchestrator blocks. It creates the four campaign Modal volumes, seeds the governor with ceiling 150 (basis BOOTSTRAP), and writes submit_gate.py. Subsequent dispatch is blocked until SETUP returns OK with component hashes.

nodes.label: BUDGET
nodes.summary: Long-lived singleton on a 15-minute cycle. It manages metered-spend queries and updates the governor after T0, publishes per-target totals and weights, writes WAKE when spending falls behind pace, and runs the campaign-wide sandbox reap sweep.

nodes.label: WATCHDOG
nodes.summary: Long-lived singleton on a 5-minute cycle. If the orchestrator heartbeat becomes older than 15 minutes, it posts a stall notice and writes WAKE. It can halt GPU dispatch by setting the governor ceiling to 0 on an inactive orchestrator or runaway GPU count. It also re-dispatches BUDGET if the BUDGET liveness file becomes stale.

nodes.label: CLOCK
nodes.summary: Long-lived singleton dispatched within the first 15 minutes. It records elapsed fraction and remaining hours every 5 minutes to prevent orchestrator clock estimation errors.

nodes.label: SCRIBE
nodes.summary: Executes the canonical function generating metrics for Slack updates and reports via fresh server-side SUM/COUNT queries over the ledger. On each hourly cycle, it re-dispatches any singleton whose liveness file is stale.

nodes.label: DISPATCH
nodes.summary: Receives work lists from the orchestrator and submits jobs through submit_gate(). On each 15-minute cycle, it recomputes the (target, method) structure-count matrix to ensure asterisked methods reach 50 backbones per target.

nodes.label: DELIVERABLES
nodes.summary: DELIVERABLES coordinator authorized to create folders and upload files in Google Drive. It executes campaign close-out as an unblocked child process: topping up seeds, resolving per-target conform, swap, and blocker decisions, and writing close_out/ artifacts.

nodes.label:
monitor
1 per 10 jobs
nodes.match: For every 10 jobs you maintain, launch a monitor sub-agent
nodes.summary: Assigned at a ratio of one monitor per 10 active jobs. It tracks job liveness, ingests completed outputs into the design-count ledger (including non-zero exits that wrote output files), and terminates sandboxes after successful compute_done confirmation. The orchestrator briefs define job assignments and completion notification paths.

nodes.label: submit_gate()
nodes.summary: Shared module created by SETUP that gates GPU job submission. Each invocation checks current state and returns False if the governor is stale or zero, if a scoring job lacks a PASS target gate, or if generation exceeds twice scored designs.

nodes.label: /state/governor.json
nodes.summary: Maintains the campaign-wide GPU concurrency ceiling. Four writers are authorized: SETUP at T0, BUDGET on 15-minute cycles, WATCHDOG on failure (ceiling 0), and the orchestrator on resume. Governors older than 25 minutes default to ceiling 0.

nodes.label: /state/gates/{target}.json
nodes.summary: Per-target validation gate record storing fold recapitulation, positive-control separation, and frozen construct definitions. Production scoring requires a PASS record. The prompt specifies readers for this file but omits an explicit writer role.

nodes.label: /state/heartbeat.json
nodes.summary: Orchestrator heartbeat containing {set_at_utc, frame_id, pending_dispatch}, updated on each main loop iteration. WATCHDOG evaluates orchestrator liveness using heartbeat age, and GPU jobs exit on launch if the file is older than 30 minutes.

nodes.label: /state/WAKE
nodes.summary: Wake-up file checked by the orchestrator after wait_for_notification calls. WATCHDOG writes WAKE if the heartbeat goes stale; BUDGET writes WAKE with reallocation instructions when spending falls behind pace.

nodes.label: /state/ledger_agg.json
nodes.summary: Per-target generation and scoring totals aggregated from ledger files by BUDGET on each cycle. In submit_gate(), new generation jobs for a target are blocked once generated designs exceed 200 and more than twice the scored count.

nodes.label: /ledger/{writer_frame_id}.jsonl
nodes.summary: Design-count ledger using one JSONL subfile per writing frame, preventing concurrent volume write corruption. Each row records one completed job, providing the underlying data for all reported campaign totals.

nodes.label: /ledger/job_metadata/*.jsonl
nodes.summary: Records job metadata (job_id, target, launching frame, GPU type, estimated hourly rate) appended immediately when submit_gate() returns True. Appending is required before dispatch; BUDGET reads these entries to compute rate-card spend, and sandbox termination requires a matching job_id.

nodes.label: Modal GPU sandboxes
nodes.summary: Modal GPU sandboxes dispatched after submit_gate() returns True. Sandboxes inspect the governor and heartbeat on startup, exiting immediately if either signals a halt. Termination is restricted to BUDGET reap passes or monitors handling successful jobs.

nodes.label: Slack thread
nodes.summary: Slack channel for status updates, stall alerts, and notifications. All reported figures must originate from the SCRIBE function.

nodes.label: Google Drive
nodes.summary: Google Drive storage for campaign deliverables. Only the DELIVERABLES coordinator may create folders or upload files, restricted to a single campaign folder containing one close_out/ subdirectory.
